title: hibiscus spinulosus
intro: Hibiscus spinulosus, commonly known as the spiny hibiscus, is a species of flowering plant in the mallow family, Malvaceae. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to help lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Hibiscus spinulosus include its potential to aid in treating fever, diarrhea, and wounds, as well as its use as a natural remedy for respiratory issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Hibiscus spinulosus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and anthraquinones, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
